candidate.answerReason: With common denominator 24, the five numerators are 8, 6, 9, 10, and 7. The largest numerator is 10, corresponding to 5/12.

methods.label: Compare equal-sized parts
methods.explanation:
All five denominators divide \(24\), so rewrite the fractions in twenty-fourths:
\[
\frac13=\frac8{24},\quad
\frac14=\frac6{24},\quad
\frac38=\frac9{24},\quad
\frac5{12}=\frac{10}{24},\quad
\frac7{24}=\frac7{24}.
\]
The parts now have the same size, so the fraction with the largest numerator is largest. Since \(10\) is the largest numerator, the answer is \(\boxed{\frac5{12}}\), choice D.
